home.title: Studio Demo — beauty salon and hair extension courses in Warsaw
home.description: Hair extensions, colour and care in Warsaw. An in-person intensive and an online micro-capsule extension course with an international certificate.

salon.title: Salon services and prices — Studio Demo, Warsaw
salon.description: Advanced colour, going from black and extensions matched to your hair. Every stylist was trained by Olena Demchenko and works to the same standard.

courses.title: Hair extension courses — Studio Demo
courses.description: Olena Demchenko's own programmes: micro-capsule extensions and hair reconstruction — in-person intensives at our Warsaw studio and online courses. You finish with an international certificate.

about.title: About — Studio Demo
about.description: A beauty salon and training courses under one brand. Both rest on 20+ years of practice by our founder, Olena Demchenko — in our stylists' work and in our student programmes.

contacts.title: Contact — Studio Demo, Warsaw
contacts.description: Get in touch however suits you — we're happy to answer questions about salon treatments or training

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Studio Demo
privacy.description: How Studio Demo processes personal data on the site: what we collect, why, who we share it with and what your rights are.

terms.title: Public offer — Studio Demo
terms.description: Terms for buying the online course and the intensive on the Studio Demo site: payment, access, refunds.

cabinet.certIntro: Your certificate is e-mailed to you automatically once you’ve watched every lesson of the course. You can always open and download it here.
cabinet.certNone: Your certificate will appear here once you’ve watched every lesson of an online course.
cabinet.certWaitName: The studio will issue your certificate. Please check that your name for the certificate is filled in under Settings.
cabinet.helpIntro: Questions about the course, access or payment — write to us and we’ll reply.
cabinet.helpQCert: How do I get my certificate?
cabinet.helpACert: Watch every lesson of the course and mark it as watched. The certificate is e-mailed to you automatically with the name from Settings, and it appears under «Certificates».
cabinet.helpQPassword: How do I change my password?
cabinet.helpAPassword: Go to «Settings» → «Change password». If you’ve forgotten it, click «Forgot your password?» on the sign-in page.
cabinet.helpADevice: One account — one device: signing in on another device ends the previous session. Just sign in again.
cabinet.helpQEmail: How do I change my e-mail?
cabinet.helpAEmail: Your e-mail can be changed through the studio — write to us using any of the options above.

payments.title: Payments
payments.note: Refunds are made in the Stripe dashboard; after a refund, course access is removed automatically.

students.title: Students

add.heading: Add a student manually
add.note: Cash or another payment method: the account is created, the course is opened, and an e-mail with a “set your password” link is sent.

suspicious.heading: Suspicious logins
suspicious.note: A login from another country less than 24 hours after the previous one. The student and the admin get an e-mail; blocking is manual.

students.blockConfirm: Block {email}? Her session ends and she cannot log in until you unblock her.

courseTable.heading: Courses — price on the site
courseTable.note: A whole number in euros. Empty field — the site keeps the price from the course text. The new price appears in the catalogue, on the home page and on the course page (if you don’t see it right away, refresh the page again).

services.heading: Salon services
services.note: An empty field shows on the site as “to be confirmed” (duration) or an empty cell (price). One button saves the whole group.
